method: dial vernier caliper measurement; Materials and methods: 'Measurements were taken with a Mitutoyo dial vernier caliper (505–671) to the nearest 0.1 mm'; the abbreviation list prints only 'E, eye' (no definition of which dimension of the eye E gives, so the value is filed as sensory_anatomy, not eye_diameter_mm)

Description of the holotype states 'Eye covered by translucent skin, surrounded by a narrow whitish ring.' and 'Eye slightly closer to the lip than to the top of the head in lateral view'. The sentence compares the eye with the naris (N 0.3 mm) and the tentacular papillus (TP 0.65 mm). Table 1 of the paper gives eye-to-eye, eye-naris, eye-lip and eye-snout distances but no eye size row. No tympanum or ear is mentioned in the paper.
